metrics_note.clip_dir: cos( CLIP(gen)-CLIP(src), CLIP(target_style_proto)-CLIP(src) ) - Measures edit direction.
metrics_note.clip_style: cos( CLIP(gen), CLIP(target_style_proto) ) - Measures absolute style similarity.
metrics_note.clip_s_delta_idt: Row/pool CLIP-S minus the fixed old-IDT CLIP-S baseline when provided.
metrics_note.clip_t: cos( CLIP(gen), CLIP(text target style name) ) - Text-name style affinity.
metrics_note.clip_content: cos( CLIP(gen), CLIP(src) ) - Measures semantic/content preservation.
metrics_note.introstyle_target_style_score: IntroStyle similarity to the held-out target-style bank.
metrics_note.introstyle_source_style_score: IntroStyle similarity to the held-out source-style bank.
metrics_note.introstyle_best_non_target_score: Strongest IntroStyle similarity among non-target banks.
metrics_note.introstyle_delta_idt: Pool-level IntroStyle target score minus the identity pool target score.
metrics_note.fid_baseline: FID between source-domain images and target-style references.
metrics_note.fid: FID between generated images and target-style real references (Inception features).
metrics_note.art_fid_fid: Academic ArtFID style term: FID computed with the official art-domain Inception checkpoint.
metrics_note.art_fid_content_lpips: Academic ArtFID content term: mean LPIPS-Alex between generated and source content images.
metrics_note.kid_baseline: KID between source-domain images and target-style references (torchmetrics).
metrics_note.kid: KID between generated images and target-style references (torchmetrics).

idt_baselines.note: clip_s_delta_idt uses the fixed old-IDT baseline when provided; eval identity baselines are stored only for audit.
